name: @pipeworx/mcp-nasa-eonet

tools.name: events
tools.description: Natural hazard events tracked by NASA EONET (the Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker): wildfires, severe storms, volcanoes, floods, icebergs, landslides, dust and haze. Filter by open or closed status, lookback days, category id, bounding box, reporting source, and magnitude range. Returns each event id, title, category, date-stamped geometry (point or polygon), and links to the reporting agency, answering where wildfires, storms, or eruptions are active now and where they occurred recently.

days.description: Lookback window in days (default 30, default 30 for closed)

magnitude_id.description: Filter by magnitude id (e.g. "ac" for acres)

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Fetch a single event by EONET id.

tools.name: geojson
tools.description: Same as events but returns GeoJSON FeatureCollection (good for direct map rendering).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Return all EONET event category definitions (id, title, description, layers) used to filter the events and geojson tools.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Return all official data sources (id, title, homepage URL) that EONET aggregates natural-event records from.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: Visualization layer reference (mapping the events to imagery layers).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nasa-eonet forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nasa-eonet pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
